_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6)**_

The yellow background is a **"slow" warning state** — after the spinner has been running for **30 seconds**, the overlay transitions from the default blue-tinted background to yellow. It's a visual cue that the LLM call is taking longer than expected, signaling the user that something may be slow or stalled (and drawing attention to the Stop button, which also turns yellow/amber).
